items.prompt: A small fishing harbor town where all colors are washed out to grey and faded blue, like an old watercolor left in the rain, laundry and nets hanging still.

items.name: 幕_碼頭上等船的人
items.prompt: A long wooden pier lined with seated people seen from behind, all looking out at an empty foggy sea, waiting for a ship.

items.name: 幕_模糊的臉
items.prompt: A quiet villager turning around on a pier, his face soft and blurred like smudged watercolor, other waiting figures behind him in the mist.

items.name: 幕_港裡的海燕號
items.prompt: At the far end of a misty harbor, an old fishing sailboat with its sails furled, a small lamp at its stern, a lone fisherman in a raincoat mending a net on deck.

items.name: 幕_只有輪廓的島
items.prompt: A small island in thick fog drawn only in faint ink outlines with no color, like an unfinished sketch, half of it sunk in calm water.

items.name: 幕_門開著的屋子
items.prompt: Inside a half-flooded stone cottage, the door left open, bowls still set neatly on the wooden table, calm water covering the floor.

items.name: 幕_白花樹
items.prompt: A large old tree covered in white blossoms standing in the middle of a quiet grey village, petals drifting slowly in the fog.

items.name: 幕_樹下數星星
items.prompt: A small girl lying under a tree full of white blossoms at night, pointing up at the stars through the branches, a gentle lantern beside her.

items.name: 幕_刮掉的名字
items.prompt: Close-up of rough tree bark where carved letters have been scraped away, only one small carved character mark left, white petals around it.

items.name: 幕_霧裡的白塔
items.prompt: A very tall white stone tower rising out of the fog, a huge bronze bell visible at its top, ancient ruined city below.

items.name: 幕_牆上的水線
items.prompt: An ancient city wall with a clear dark watermark line far above human height, a small traveler standing below looking up.

items.name: 幕_跪著的石像們
items.prompt: Rows of stone statues of people kneeling in an ancient ruined plaza, all looking up toward a distant white tower in the fog.

items.name: 幕_塔頂的大鐘
items.prompt: A huge ancient bronze bell at the top of a white tower, its surface covered with thousands of tiny engraved marks, mist swirling around it.

items.name: 幕_鐘響時消失的島
items.prompt: Seen from a high tower, a distant small island on the misty sea fading into fog as rings of sound ripple out from a great bell.

items.name: 幕_掛滿地圖的房間
items.prompt: An enormous old drawing room inside the fog, every wall covered from floor to ceiling with framed hand-drawn sea charts, a tiny silhouette of a person standing in the middle, dim candlelight.

items.name: 幕_沒有空白的地圖
items.prompt: Close-up of an extremely detailed antique sea chart with every inch filled with islands, rocks, waves and tiny markings, not a single blank space left, oppressive and perfect.

items.name: 幕_窗外灰色的海
items.prompt: A tall window in a dark drawing room, outside the window the sea and an island have turned completely grey and frozen still like a painting, a silhouette watching from inside.

items.name: 幕_畫桌上的星筆
items.prompt: A large wooden drawing desk with an unfinished map, an old pen with a star-shaped tip glowing warm gold resting on it, candle wax and ink stains.

items.name: 幕_人形的空白
items.prompt: Beside a drawing desk, on the dark wooden floor, a pale empty human-shaped blank space as if someone's shadow had been cut out with scissors, eerie quiet light.

items.name: 幕_一片白
items.prompt: A vast endless field of pure white mist at the center of the sea, nothing at all visible, soft and silent, only the faintest hint of a horizon.

items.name: 幕_纏在一起的光
items.prompt: Inside a white void, two ribbons of light, one warm gold and one pale blue, twisting and coiling around each other like two strokes of a pen in a duel.

items.name: 幕_停在半空的筆
items.prompt: A very old man in a worn guild robe holding a pen with a star-shaped tip, the pen frozen in mid-air in the middle of a white void, just one stroke left to draw.

items.name: 幕_擋在筆前的女人
items.prompt: Back view of a woman in a pale grey traveling cloak with a faintly blue-glowing pen standing with one arm raised, blocking an old man's glowing golden pen in a white void, the blue and gold light pushing against each other.

items.name: 幕_回頭的女人
items.prompt: A woman with long dark hair tied back, pale grey traveling cloak, turning around in a white misty void and giving a gentle tired smile, soft blue glow, face kindly visible.

items.name: 幕_霧散的群島
items.prompt: A bright clear sky over an archipelago as the last fog dissolves away, sunlit blue sea, many green islands fully visible to the horizon, warm daylight.

items.name: 幕_繁忙的港口
items.prompt: A busy prosperous harbor crowded with dozens of sailing ships under clear sunny skies, colorful flags, bustling docks.

items.name: 幕_畫滿的海圖
items.prompt: An open old map book whose pages are completely filled with drawn islands and routes, not a single blank space, a pen laid down beside it.

items.name: 幕_碼頭上的小孩
items.prompt: A small child sitting at the edge of a wooden pier on a sunny day, quietly looking at a calm flat sea with a perfectly clear horizon, nothing unknown left.

items.name: 幕_平靜的海
items.prompt: A perfectly calm, flat, sunlit sea stretching to the horizon, peaceful but strangely still, no fog, no waves.

items.name: 幕_回來的薄霧
items.prompt: A thin gentle mist returning over the sea at twilight, soft and quiet, grey lanterns glowing along the edge of the fog.

items.name: 幕_有燈的島
items.prompt: Several islands in thin mist at dusk, islands with lit warm windows and lanterns stand clear while the fog parts around them, one unlit island fades softly into the fog.

items.name: 幕_門前的母女
items.prompt: Two figures, a 17-year-old girl with short black hair with one white streak, deep-blue old sailor coat, leather satchel and a woman in a pale grey traveling cloak with a faintly blue-glowing pen, standing side by side before a towering gate made of ice under a starry night, holding small lights, guardians of the gate.

items.name: 幕_每年一次的船
items.prompt: A small sailing boat arriving at a lamplit wooden pier at dusk, people on the pier waving, a once-a-year reunion.

items.name: 幕_一路的灰燈
items.prompt: A long line of grey lanterns on poles standing in the shallow sea, stretching into soft fog toward the horizon, quiet and enduring.

items.name: 幕_飛向港口的書頁
items.prompt: Hundreds of pages torn from an old map book flying on the wind across the sea toward distant harbors, a girl with a satchel watching them from a cliff at dawn.

items.name: 幕_大家都在畫
items.prompt: On a lively harbor at sunset, fishermen, children, pirates and merchants all sitting on the dock drawing their own maps on single pages, warm and joyful.

items.name: 幕_亂糟糟的海圖
items.prompt: A chaotic colorful sea chart drawn by many different hands, overlapping lines in red, blue, green and purple ink, the same island drawn many different ways, messy and full of life.

items.name: 幕_紅帆的船隊
items.prompt: A fleet of ships with deep red sails sailing out of light fog together, banners flying, lanterns on their bows.

items.name: 幕_熱鬧的夜市
items.prompt: A crowded night market on a harbor full of warm lanterns, people laughing and trading hand-drawn maps, lively and festive.

items.name: 幕_正中間的空白
items.prompt: An old sea chart with many islands drawn in a ring around the edges, and a perfectly round blank space left untouched in the very center, softly glowing.

items.name: 幕_清晨的霧
items.prompt: Early morning on a small harbor island with a lighthouse, a light morning mist lying gently over the water, sunrise colors beginning to show.

items.name: 幕_太陽出來霧散了
items.prompt: The morning sun rising over the sea and the light mist dissolving in golden sunlight, revealing calm water, hopeful and warm.

items.name: 幕_站在空白邊緣的母親
items.prompt: A woman in a pale grey cloak standing at the edge of a large blank white circle on a giant map laid over the sea, looking toward the viewer, soft blue glow.

items.name: 幕_母親叫她的名字
items.prompt: A mother and her 17-year-old daughter with short black hair and a white streak standing face to face on a beach at sunrise, the mother's hand on the girl's cheek, warm emotional reunion.

items.name: 幕_鹽灣島的碼頭
items.prompt: The wooden pier of a small fishing harbor at golden evening, many friends gathered and waving, a lighthouse on the hill, ships coming home.

items.name: 幕_回家的船
items.prompt: An old fishing ship named Swallow sailing home into a harbor at dawn, a father and his son standing at the bow, an old turtle and an old fisherman on the pier.

items.name: 幕_書的最後一頁
items.prompt: The last page of an old map book open on a desk under lamplight, a simple drawing of a group of friends standing together on a pier, the rest of the page still blank.

items.name: 幕_礁上的醉鯨
items.prompt: At low tide, a huge sleeping whale lying half out of a shallow coral reef, its back covered in seaweed, small white flowers and barnacles, so large it looks like an island, a few empty wooden barrels stuck between the rocks, gentle mist, a faint pale moon, peaceful and a little sad.

items.name: 幕_漂著的酒桶
items.prompt: Night sea seen close to the water surface, a line of old wooden barrels drifting slowly toward a misty horizon, on the horizon the faint dark silhouette of a whale spouting a thin plume of water, soft ripples catching moonlight, quiet and lonely.

items.name: 幕_沙洲上的金船
items.prompt: A long white sandbar in the middle of a calm sea, on it lies the ruined skeleton of a large old sailing ship whose hull ribs and planks are made of real gold, glinting warmly in low evening sun through thin mist, small tents of salvagers in the far distance, wide view.

items.name: 幕_數金幣的影子
items.prompt: Inside a cramped ship captain's cabin piled to the ceiling with gold coins, a dark translucent shadow figure in an old formal merchant coat sits on top of the coin pile hunched over a thick ledger, counting coins one by one, only warm candlelight, lonely and eerie.

items.name: 幕_火山島的紅帆
items.prompt: A small red volcanic island shaped like a closed eye rising from a dark sea, faint smoke from its crater, on the black sand beach a single tall flagpole with a tattered crimson sail flapping hard in the wind, dramatic clouds, wide view from the sea.

items.name: 幕_獨眼船長
items.prompt: Deep inside a hot volcanic cave lit by glowing red gems, a tall translucent ghost of an old pirate captain with a tricorn hat and one glowing ember-like eye sits on a heap of treasure and old red sails, holding a curved sword faintly burning, stern but lonely.

items.name: 幕_撞開的冰層
items.prompt: A small wooden sailing ship with a heavy iron ice-breaking bow pushing through thick cracked sea ice in a frozen northern sea, shards of blue ice flying, below the broken ice a huge dark hollow cavern glows faintly, cold mist and pale light.

items.name: 幕_沒造完的船
items.prompt: A vast ice cavern under the frozen sea, in the center a huge unfinished wooden sailing ship sits on an old slipway, only half its hull planked, its white keel and ribs exposed like a skeleton, frozen hammers and tools hanging in the air, a tiny warm lamp in a cabin in the corner, solemn and quiet.
